paper.title: Ether lipid remodeling during neuronal differentiation prevents ferroptosis
paper.caption: Plasmalogen deficiency increases sensitivity to iron-induced toxicity in C. elegans (A) Survival analysis of wild-type ( wt ) and tmem-189 mutant (ko) C. elegans exposed to increasing concentrati ns of ferric ammonium citrate (FAC). (B) Schematic experimental workflow of animal treatment for locomotion analysis. (C) Locomotor performance and (D) quantification of wild-type and tmem-189 mutant animals exposed to sublethal FAC concentrations and rescue with ferrostatin-1 (Fer-1). Error bars are SEM of 18-39 replicates.
